text: This report recommends that the name "Antonios Mavrakakis Lane" be approved to identify a public lane north of Danforth Avenue, extending between Logan Avenue and Ferrier Avenue. Community Councils have delegated authority to decide street naming matters which comply with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Antonios Mavrakakis Lane" for a public lane north of Danforth Avenue, extending between Logan Avenue and Ferrier Avenue.
